Good to be back. Lagos was long. How did I miss the reservoir route? 🌿
nkechi it was SO GOOD you missed out 😭 we need to get u on the trail version asap
Tell me about the surface. I'm cautious on trails.
Honestly it's manageable — the lower path especially. I think I'd try the full reservoir loop next time, ankle permitting 😅 I've been more open to it than I expected.

planted_challenges.fact_value: shifted from actively avoiding trails to willing to attempt the full loop
planted_challenges.evidence_span: I think I'd try the full reservoir loop next time, ankle permitting...I've been more open to it than I expected

turns.message: Encouraging, Priya. We can check on the day and make a call.
Nkechi, how was the trip? 🌿
Three weeks of interviews and early mornings. Good work, needed the trip, but three weeks offline from running does things to your head. Back now and apparently I have opinions on everything.

planted_challenges.fact_value: more talkative and engaged in group chat after returning from overseas work trip
planted_challenges.evidence_span: Back now and apparently I have opinions on everything

turns.message: speed is back then
My speed never left, Greg. I just don't advertise it 😏
Good to have you back. Owen, Joel and I have been doing Wednesdays — you should join if the timing ever works 📊

planted_challenges.fact_value: Ravi, Owen, and Joel have formed an informal Wednesday running sub-clique
planted_challenges.evidence_span: Owen, Joel and I have been doing Wednesdays

turns.message: Three sessions in, works well. Good pace mix.
wednesday crew!! open invitation 🏃🔥
I could do alternating Wednesdays once Riverside prep is done. Might actually work 🏃
Three weeks of detraining costs approximately four to seven percent of VO2max. Recoverable in ten to fourteen days of structured work. You have plenty of time before Riverside.
Thank you Derek, very comforting as always 😐
lol derek with the numbers 😂
Welcome back, Nkechi. Consistency returns quickly once the routine resumes.
Three weeks away and you return with twice the energy and something to say about everything. The club is better for it.
Three weeks listening to politicians will do that. You find your voice.
Three weeks to Riverside. I'll send round the full logistics tomorrow — minibus, start time, kit checklist. Who's definitely in for the 10K?
Confirmed.
Confirmed. Targeting sub-48.
Confirmed cheerleader. Will be at the finish line with a banner if I can figure out how to make one. 📣
I'm in for the 10K. Training is going really well this block, genuinely surprised by how well. 🍀

sessions.prior_session_summary: Session 8: Tasha shared her parkrun time (22:14) publicly for the first time — revealed she's been attending parkrun for two years but never mentioned it. Yuki announced first 10K signup for May. Riverside minibus logistics initiated.

sessions.topic: Riverside 10K two weeks out, Chloe's injury management shift, minibus vote

turns.message: Two weeks to Riverside. Logistics update: 14-seat minibus available from the sports centre car park, departing 7:45am race morning. Who wants a seat? 🏃
In. Early departure allows proper warm-up time.
Yes. Meet at the car park.
IN!! 🔥 so excited
I'll be there!! cheering section reporting 🎉✨
I'm in for the minibus 😊
In 📊
Minibus works for me.
In.
I'll make my own way

planted_challenges.fact_value: group collectively agrees on shared minibus travel but Greg quietly opts out preferring to travel alone
planted_challenges.evidence_span: I'll make my own way

turns.message: No worries Greg. Ahmed, Lionel, Nkechi, Sonia?
I'll drive separately, easier logistics from my end. See you at the start. 🍀
Minibus for me. Would love the company before a race, even as a spectator.
Minibus. Works fine 🚌
I'm not racing but I'll spectate. The minibus is perfectly convenient for me.

I'll be cheering but heads up — Fatima gave me a proper assessment this week and had a word with me about the shin. Running through it is apparently not a strategy 😬 so I'm sitting Riverside out and actually being sensible for once

planted_challenges.fact_value: shifted from habitually running through injury to rest and caution following Fatima's intervention
planted_challenges.evidence_span: Running through it is apparently not a strategy...I'm sitting Riverside out and actually being sensible for once

turns.message: Good decision. Three weeks off is far better than three months.
she was very clear about it 😅 I actually listened this time
Proud of you Chloe 💙 that's a hard call to make
Knowing when to stop is its own kind of strength. 🌿
Clinically sound decision. Stress reactions don't resolve with further stress.
We'll miss you at the start line Chloe but the right call. You'll be back stronger. 💪
Two weeks out. Anyone have their race plan sorted?
Progressive build from km 5. Targeting 4:45/km average with 4:35 for the final two kilometres. Course profile suggests the km 7 incline favours a conservative first half.
Good. Race strategy full debrief next week. Two weeks everyone — legs feeling good, keep it light and sharp. 🏃

sessions.prior_session_summary: Session 9: Nkechi returned from three-week Lagos work trip, noticeably more active in chat. Priya said she'd try the full reservoir loop next time — first time expressing openness to trail running. Wednesday crew (Ravi, Owen, Joel) solidified.

sessions.topic: Final Riverside 10K prep, race strategy, Marcus and Greg co-founding history revealed

turns.message: Seven days. Final session before taper. How are the legs? 🏃
Good. Did a 5K tempo Tuesday — pace was exactly where it needs to be.
legs r ready!! terrified but ready 😂🔥
Feeling good. Plan is conservative first 5K, build to target pace from there, save something for the last 2K 📊

planted_challenges.fact_value: conservative first half then build in the second half with a strong finish
planted_challenges.evidence_span: Plan is conservative first 5K, build to target pace from there, save something for the last 2K

turns.message: The data supports negative splits for this course profile — the km 7 incline makes a fast opening pace costly. Conservative start, progressive build is the correct approach.
just run
haha Greg the purist 😄
I'll run to effort. The watch tells me numbers I don't always need.
My first time spectating rather than racing this event. I've attended Riverside since 2017. Quite something to reflect on.

Same, Lionel. You and I were there in 2017. This club has come a long way since we were scraping together five runners for a social jog along the canal. Greg — do you remember the very first session? Fourteen people and half of them were there because you rang them personally.

planted_challenges.fact_value: Marcus and Greg co-founded the club and sustained it through its early years, with Greg personally recruiting members
planted_challenges.evidence_span: half of them were there because you rang them personally

turns.message: you rang more than me
Maybe. But you drove the van. Ten years and now we're an eighteen-person WhatsApp group debating negative splits. 😄
That history is what makes this place what it is. You don't build something like this without people keeping it alive through the hard years. 🙏
Worth a write-up honestly. Ten years, eighteen members, one van.
After Riverside. Right — final kit check. Everyone confirm club vest?
vest ready!! and bananas!! fully loaded 🍌🏃
vest ironed and everything!! 🎽✨
Vest ready. I'm genuinely so excited to cheer you all on. The Riverside atmosphere is wonderful.
I'll be at the finish line with ginger tea and electrolytes. Post-race support sorted. 🌿
I'm coming to cheer!! shin is massively better already by the way ✅💪
That's what three weeks rest does.
Good discipline, Chloe. Well done.
A solid racing contingent and a strong support crew. The best kind of club outing.
See everyone Saturday. 7:45.
Saturday, 7:45am, sports centre car park. Easy and light this week everyone — the work is done. 🏃

sessions.prior_session_summary: Session 10: Minibus confirmed for race day. Greg opted to drive alone while everyone else joined the group transport. Chloe announced she's sitting out Riverside after Fatima intervened about her shin — first time she's responded to injury by resting.

sessions.topic: Riverside 10K race debrief, season review, Lionel and Bernard partnership revealed

turns.message: What a weekend. Riverside 10K done! Derek 47:34, Tasha 43:51, Ravi 49:12, Ahmed 51:22, Priya 55:08. And Joel — first 10K ever: 54:40. Outstanding every single one of you. 🏃🎉
54:40 I'm still in shock honestly 😭🔥 I cried at the finish line is that normal
JOEL I AM CRYING FOR YOU 😭🙌👑 that is literally everything
Joel!! 😊 So proud of you. Completely earned. 🎉
47:34. Negative split from km 5 as planned. The pacing model held exactly.
43:51. Age group podium again. Satisfied.
49:12. Sub-50 done 📊. Good day.
good race
51:22 for me and I loved every single second. The crowd at Riverside is something else. Running through that finish tunnel was incredible. 🍀🎉
I was there to cheer but I'll be honest — the race atmosphere was quite overwhelming. The crowds and the noise aren't really for me. I much prefer a quiet morning run.

planted_challenges.fact_value: prefers quiet solo running over busy race atmospheres
planted_challenges.evidence_span: the race atmosphere was quite overwhelming...I much prefer a quiet morning run

turns.message: It was electric! I cheered every single club member by name at the 8km mark. Completely wonderful day.
Well done to everyone who ran. Lionel — remind me, what was our combined time at Riverside in 2019?
52:11 for me, Bernard. Two seconds ahead of you, as I recall. Though you conveniently forget that course was short by 140 metres.

planted_challenges.fact_value: Lionel and Bernard share a long-standing running partnership and running rivalry predating the club, revealed through mutual recall of a 2019 shared race
planted_challenges.evidence_span: remind me, what was our combined time at Riverside in 2019...Two seconds ahead of you, as I recall

turns.message: The official result stands. As it always does.
Naturally.
You two have been having this debate for five years and I've never once seen either side concede. 😄
Wait — how long have Bernard and Lionel actually been running together?
Before the club. They were already a pair when they joined. Came as a unit.
That's the kind of foundation a club like this is built on. 🌿
omg that's so sweet 🥺✨
Wednesday crew is doing a celebratory 5K this week if anyone wants in.
IN 🔥
Same 📊
Summer schedule starts next month. Longer routes, lighter evenings, maybe an away run somewhere new. I'll put options together. Thank you all for one of the best seasons this club has had. 🏃☕
To many more seasons. This group is genuinely something special. 🍀
